newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Bank Handlowy to launch CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Polish Bank Handlowy to launch CD programme.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA will launch its certificates of deposit programme on July 1 which envisions fixed coupon CDs of between one- and 12-months maturity issued to banks, Handlowy said.
The CDs will have a face value of 100,000 zlotys each, can be purchased by both domestic and foreign banks, and may be traded on the primary and secondary market.
Handlowy expected the weekly turnover on the CDs to be between 200 and 300 million zlotys.
"Dealers are mainly interested in shorter-term CDs, which could serve as competition to repos," Wlodzimierz Kado, dealer at Bank Handlowy SA told Reuters.
Fixed interest rates on the CDs will be determined individually for each issue and the coupon is negotiable.
Handlowy said it would offer its CDs with standard due dates at monthly intervals but banks could also individually agree on other maturities.
